answer: Use a vouching graph with scarce, decaying endorsements: an established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, leaving a visible onyx-like record linking voucher to newcomer. A newcomer earns a pearl of standing only after its voucher's past vouchees behaved honestly for several epochs. If a vouched identity cheats, the voucher loses endorsement power and standing, so creating hollow shells costs real reputation. An attacker needing thousands of identities must build thousands of trusted histories or bribe many independent vouchers, far costlier than one honest join.
